description: This Java class 'IncomingSignal' acts as an immutable wrapper for a 'Signal' object, marking it as incoming for a streaming session within the Eclipse Ditto gateway streaming service. It provides static factory methods, accessor methods, and overrides for 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString'.

classes.name: IncomingSignal
classes.description: Immutable class representing an incoming signal envelope, wrapping a 'Signal' object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of IncomingSignal by wrapping a given Signal.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the wrapped Signal object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare IncomingSignal instances based on the wrapped Signal.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to produce a hash code based on the wrapped Signal.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the IncomingSignal including its class name and the wrapped signal.
